decisions.reason: As a recently launched but relatively low-investment cleaning accessory that fits the established floor-care offer and is already publicly listed, management would likely keep it and treat any weak early uptake as temporary.
This maintenance oil line extends the core surface-treatment business with several models, so the firm has made a broader commitment and is likely to continue rather than admit an early reversal.
Because this care line for oiled wood floors closely supports the installed base, involves multiple variants, and was visibly launched, management is likely to persist with it.

The moisture-protection underlay complements the flooring system and supports the firm's full-solution positioning, so despite being easier to drop than a core floor product it is still likely to be retained.
This underlay foam is a peripheral but still complementary add-on, and with the product newly introduced and publicly offered, management would more likely continue than withdraw it quickly.
The oak parquet line is close to the firm's core business, likely required meaningful development and commercial commitment, and therefore management is strongly inclined to keep it on the market.
